Die zweite Aufgabe, dreht sich um Licht, Schatten und einen unzerstörbaren Stein. Aufgrund des geschwächten Zustandes von Yugi, machen sich Joey und Tristan auf den Weg und treffen in einem Tal auf ein mächtiges Glaswesen.

Durch den Verzehrs eines Apfels, verwandelt sich Yugi in den Magier des schwarzen Chaos. Jetzt kämpft er in der vierten Prüfung gegen eine Riesenmotte. Nach der Opferung eines weiteren Apfels der Verwandlung, gelangen die Freunde zu einem Portal.

Nur der weiße Drache, welcher zur Stärkung regelmäßig menschliche Seelen braucht, kann ein Dorf vor den Finsteren Fünf Drachen beschützen. Um eine Opferung zu vermeiden, treten Yugi und seine Freunde gegen die Finsteren Fünf Drachen an.
Yugi must duel a magical doppelganger of Kaiba, created from the greed and power lust Yugi wiped from Kaiba's soul.
Yugi defeats the Blue Eyes White Dragon, but there are two more waiting in the wings! Will the real Kaiba reach Yugi in time to help beat this impersonator?
Joey decides to battle Rex Raptor without his friends' help to prove that he is man enough to take care of Serenity on his own.
Joey duels valiantly, but Rex Raptor has unleashed his secret weapon: the Red Eyes Black Dragon!
Yugi's classmate Bakura, possessed by his Millennium Ring's dark powers, traps Yugi and friends in a Shadow Game where they become the cards themselves!

Pegasus's hired duelist Panik cheats Mai of all her star chips, and Yugi vows to defeat him and win them back. But when Panik's Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, how can Yugi defeat an enemy he cannot see?
Despite his astonishing disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes Panik - "I'll finish you in three turns." Is Yugi bluffing, or does he have the advantage in this battle of wits?

Kaiba descends to the kingdom to face Pegasus. Has Kaiba changed since his battle with Yugi, or is he still the same merciless duelist? A battle between Kaiba's Blue Eyes White Dragon and Joey's Red Eyes Black Dragon holds the answers!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Arena der verlorenen Seelen, Teil 1

Bandit Keith's gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith's zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Arena der verlorenen Seelen, Teil 2

Joey's last ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizrad card, fails against Bandit Keith's zombie monsters. But as his lucky streak comes to an end, will his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him to victory?
Yugi and Joey band together in a team battle against the Paradox Brothers with all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus's castle on the line!
The Paradox Brothers summon the almighty Gate Guardian, a monster that reflects all attacks! Is Joey helping Yugi in this duel, or is his lack of experience sealing their fate for defeat?
Yugi and Joey each unleash their strongest monster, the Summoned Skull and the Red Eyes Black Dragon, but their strength pales in comparison to the tremendous power of the Gate Gurdian.

In order to earn the right to challenge Pegasus, Kaiba must first beat Yugi and take his Star Chips. The rematch between Yugi and Kaiba is about to begin!
Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Stunde der Wahrheit, Teil 2

Kaiba summons the Blue Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!

Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put the Blue Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi's heart is split in two!

Having lost his star chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Tea bring YUGI back to consciousness by defeating MAI for her extra star chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegssus with Mokuba's soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people's minds.

Kyoya et Tsubasa gagnent tous deux leurs premiers combats de l'Ultime Bataille, et c'est maintenant au tour de Hyoma.
Les duels entre les adversaires de la deuxième partie sont décidés.
Le deuxième tour de l'ultime bataille commence.
C'est à présent au tour de Kenta de se battre, il doit affronter Reiji.
Tsubasa se prépare pour son combat contre Ryuga et sa toupie Lightning L-Drago. Tsubasa a un plan pour vaincre le coup spécial obscur de Ryuga.
La demi-finale de l'Ultime Bataille est excitante. Gingka affronte un adversaire terrifiant, Reiji.
